newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products - Gasoline firm on back of crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - Gasoline firm on back of crude.

text.p: NWE oil products ended mainly firmer on Friday, traders said.
Gasoline prices were firmer in line with crude and NYMEX unleaded futures and with some good buying interest for barges beginning to emerge.
Eurograde barges put on around $1 a tonne with trade at $182.50 and $183 a tonne fob ARA. Cargo prices were steady with Eurograde cargoes valued around $188 a tonne cif NWE.
Naphtha was steady to firmer but any upside was mainly on the back of firmer crude, though a Russian cargo meeting Dow spec offered into Rotterdam at around $172 a tonne set the spot market steady.
Gas oil was firmer in line with stronger benchmark IPE gas oil futures. Heating oil barges traded at July IPE +25 cents fob ARA.

High sulphur fuel oil barges were steady to a shade higher, with mid-July material done as high as $84 fob ARA, or a little over Thursday's close, after earlier trades between $83 and $83.50 while June barges were done between $82 and $83, or unchanged from a day earlier.

High sulphur cargoes were quiet but seen steady with little Russian barrels around. One percent traded but the deal was private and confidential but traders said the seller had earlier cut its asking price a little to $94.
